svg.title: The race in real seismograms
svg.desc: Record section of the M3.3 quake near Junction, Utah: the vertical-component seismogram of each of 10 University of Utah stations, drawn at its distance from the epicenter (27 to 183 km, down) against seconds after the quake (0 to 60, across). Blue dots mark the analysts' P picks (9 stations), red dots their S picks (3 stations). Dashed lines show P at 5.8 km/s and S at 3.3 km/s; the gap between them widens with distance: S − P is 4.1 s at MTPU and 10.4 s at WCU.
